evidence.message: Modeled recovery preserves entry SP and original x19–x30 at every listed conservative CFG observation
1 terminal paths checked; 0 with uncertain reachability; 2 state visits; 1 path-state observations; states retained separately at reconvergence

limitations: Only the documented, bounded integer instruction subset is interpreted.
Checks describe selected modeled states; they do not establish whole-function or asynchronous unwind correctness.
SIMD, pointer authentication, CFI outside the bounded subset, personality and LSDA semantics are outside this model.
Leaf observations are states before identified body instructions, excluding recognized prologue and epilogue transitions.

Only forward acyclic compact-frameless leaf paths with independently checked return stack regions with bounded forward EQ–LE or unconditional suffix transfers are modeled; no calls or CFI CFG extension.
Unknown supported NZCV conditions explore both successors without merging identities; possible-only discrepancies remain unresolved.
This is a bounded static model, not a proof that a binary always unwinds correctly.
Compact unwind is checked at supported synchronous call states or explicitly labeled leaf-body states; no asynchronous or all-PC guarantee is made.
Unsupported instructions, flow outside the bounded CFG and at-most-two sequential disjoint natural-loop subset, unsupported CFI, ARM64e/PAC and SIMD saves remain unresolved.
Exception personalities, LSDA behavior, runtime stack contents and executable behavior are not validated.
The inspected file is read as data and is never loaded or executed.
Selecting a .app analyzes its principal executable; embedded images are not recursively scanned in this version.
